summary: Verified new DELETE /api/transactions/{tid} feature end-to-end. Backend (3/3 pytest): (a) creating a TEST_UI/TEST_DELETE transaction decrements stock, DELETE returns {ok:true, restored_items:2}, product stock is incremented back to exact pre-sale value via $inc, transaction is gone (subsequent GET => 404), and inventory_history gains one row per item with type='delete', quantity=+sold_qty, reason='Hapus transaksi TRX-...'; (b) DELETE on unknown id => 404 with detail 'Transaksi tidak ditemukan'; (c) regression: GET /api/reports/buyer-recap contains no price/subtotal/total/cost/profit/discount fields anywhere in the tree. Frontend (Playwright, full flow): red Trash2 icon renders with data-testid=txn-delete-<id> next to eye+pencil for every row; clicking opens shadcn AlertDialog titled 'Hapus transaksi TRX-20260902-00026?' with body mentioning stock restore + '2 produk'; 'Batal' (delete-cancel) closes dialog with row intact; 'Ya, Hapus' (delete-confirm) calls the API, shows green toast 'Transaksi berhasil dihapus, stok dikembalikan', dialog closes, the row disappears from the list, and product stock returns to pre-sale values (12 and 13 restored exactly).

minor.issue: transaction_number is generated as `TRX-YYYYMMDD-<count_documents+1>`. Because the counter is based on current collection size, deleting a transaction lets the NEXT insert reuse a previously-used TRX-... number. Not part of this task, but it can cause duplicate transaction_numbers and confused audit/inventory-history reasons over time. Consider using a monotonically increasing sequence (e.g. findAndModify counter doc) or max(existing_number)+1.

action_items: (Optional, not blocking this task) Fix transaction_number generation to avoid reuse after delete — see minor backend issue.

Still pending from iteration_9 (unrelated to this task): SupplierRecap.jsx lines 105 & 244 still contain SKU fallback instead of '-' for empty descriptions — was not part of this review request but remains open.
critical_code_review_comments: delete_transaction endpoint correctly uses $inc for stock restore (atomic), logs inventory_history per line with type='delete' and reason=`Hapus transaksi {txn_number}`, and returns {ok, restored_items}. Auth is enforced via get_current_user. Good.
Frontend uses shadcn AlertDialog with proper data-testids (txn-delete-<id>, delete-cancel, delete-confirm) and a clean doDelete() handler with loading state and error toast fallback.
Minor: no admin-only guard on DELETE — any authenticated user (including future cashier role if added) can delete transactions and restore stock. Consider role check if multi-role is planned.
Minor: transaction_number reuse bug (see backend minor issue above) is triggered specifically by this new delete feature — worth an inline comment in delete_transaction or a fix to generation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all delete flows + cancel + toast + stock restore)
